Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.widgets.api

Interface Widget

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractWidget, CalendarWidget, ClockWidget, CpuWidget, MemoryWidget, SystemIndicatorsWidget, TemperatureWidget, WeatherWidget
public interface Widget
A pluggable desktop widget.

A widget is a small, self-updating 3D component that lives on the desktop layer (in front of the background, behind application windows). Implementations almost always extend AbstractWidget, which supplies the Swing-on-3D hosting, the shared update tick and the drag-to-move plumbing; this interface is the minimal contract the host layer programs against.

Lifecycle, in order:

  1. init(WidgetContext) - once, right after construction, before the node is added to the scene. The widget builds its content here.
  2. start() - when the widget becomes live on the desktop; start any periodic updates.
  3. stop() - when the widget is removed or the desktop shuts down; cancel updates but keep state so start() can resume.
  4. dispose() - final teardown; release the SwingNode and any other resources. The widget is not reused after this.
